item.title: Refactor order status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit the work on the local branch; do not push anything.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization done for the OrderStatus refactor (attempt 1, no feedback to address).

Structural goal: add src/status.rs with `OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` (Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash), `as_str`/`Display` giving lowercase names, `FromStr` with `ParseStatusError`, and `can_transition_to` (pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled). `Order::status` becomes `OrderStatus`, re-exported from the crate root with `ParseStatusError`; status literals live only in status.rs. The current guards already match that transition table (pay: pending->paid; ship: paid->shipped; cancel: from pending or paid).

Commits (branch archon/ndpnv36b-refactor-order-status-string-into-orders, nothing pushed):
- Original baseline: 26be9cb629e1cc3db82a792c2ca5ded75f3f046c (tree 6e35d20143ea2a04a1a2774dbb91a210c78ccdcf)
- Characterization: cc9006e4a69061af0903719549a010f81238d810 "test: characterize order status transitions, parsing and reports" (tree 0300aafdcc86bf62d1d974d038fa89042bd1b095). Adds tests/characterization.rs only; no production or existing test changes. Tests use `.to_string()` on statuses, so they compile whether the field is String or OrderStatus.
- Worktree is clean.

Checks (no README, CI or Makefile in the repo; cargo is at ~/.cargo/bin, not on PATH by default; CARGO_TARGET_DIR set to the item cache):
- Before tests, at 26be9cb: `cargo test --locked` exit 0, 3 passed. `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` exit 1, pre-existing: diffs in billing.rs, order.rs, report.rs, shipping.rs, tests/orders.rs (long lines). Not fixed; the refactor touches those files, so expect fmt noise there.
- After tests, at cc9006e: `cargo test --locked` exit 0, 20 passed (17 new in characterization, 3 existing). clippy -D warnings exit 0. rustfmt --check on the new file exit 0.

Public surface to preserve (exact observable behaviour):
- billing::pay(&mut Order) -> Result<(), String>; error "order {id} cannot be paid: it is {status}".
- billing::outstanding_cents(&[Order]) -> u64; sums pending orders only.
- shipping::ship(&mut Order); error "order {id} cannot be shipped: it is {status}".
- shipping::ready_to_ship(&[Order]) -> Vec<u32>; paid ids in input order.
- Order { pub id: u32, pub customer: String, pub total_cents: u64, pub status: String }, derives Debug, Clone, PartialEq; Order::new(u32, &str, u64) starts pending; is_open() true for pending/paid; cancel() errors "order {id} cannot be cancelled: it is {status}" for shipped/cancelled.
- report::status_counts(&[Order]) -> Vec<(String, usize)>; sorted by status name (alphabetical: cancelled, paid, pending, shipped), not lifecycle order.
- report::to_line -> "id,customer,total_cents,status".
- report::from_line(&str) -> Result<Order, String>: trims the whole line only; checks field count ("expected 4 fields, got N"), then id ("bad id {:?}: {e}"), then total ("bad total {:?}: {e}"), then status ("unknown status {:?}"). Case-sensitive.
- Allowed exception (brief): Order.status type changes String -> OrderStatus.
- Open decision for the refactorer: the brief says "use the enum everywhere", which might mean status_counts should return (OrderStatus, usize). That is a return-type change not explicitly allowed; output text would be identical. Recommend deciding explicitly. Tests are written to accept either.

Pinned by new tests: ship/pay/cancel refusals for every status with messages and no mutation on failure; cancel allowed only from pending/paid; is_open per status; outstanding_cents and ready_to_ship filtering and order; status_counts sort and empty input; to_line for all four statuses; from_line accepting all four and round-tripping; unknown-status messages (including "Paid" and " paid" rejected); outer-whitespace trim; wrong field counts; error precedence id->total->status; std ParseIntError messages (negative, empty, overflow); empty customer accepted; customer containing a comma fails to round-trip (pinned as-is).

Known gaps: the pub status field can currently be set to an arbitrary string, and status_counts would count it; this is unreachable through from_line and is not pinned, and the enum makes it impossible. can_transition_to and ParseStatusError are new behaviour, so no baseline exists; the refactorer should test them directly.

Services: none started, nothing left running. No artifacts published.

Not checked: downstream callers outside this repo, and the brief's "at least 2 assertions per function" rule, which I did not add because the touched functions are trivial matches and assertions would be decorative.

pr.body:
Approach: new src/status.rs holds the enum, as_str, Display (f.pad, so width behaves as for String), FromStr with ParseStatusError (message 'unknown status {:?}'), and can_transition_to (pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled). Guards in pay/ship/cancel now call can_transition_to; the old guards are equivalent to that table. from_line keeps its check order (field count, id, total, status). status_counts still returns Vec<(String, usize)> and sorts by as_str() name, not lifecycle order.

Key files: src/status.rs (new, with unit tests), src/lib.rs (private mod plus re-exports), src/order.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/report.rs.

Checks: cargo test --locked passes (6+17+3). clippy -D warnings passes. Existing and characterization tests are unchanged.

Assumptions and limits: Order.status is a public field, so external code that compares it with string literals or assigns strings will fail to compile; this is the permitted contract change. status_counts keeps its String return type because changing it is not authorized. Pre-existing fmt diffs are left alone.
pr.summary: made order status a typed enum. now: status transitions are checked by OrderStatus::can_transition_to and parsed via FromStr, and literals live only in status.rs. before: Order.status was a String compared against literals in billing, shipping, order and report; now: Order.status is OrderStatus, with identical error text, report ordering and parse errors.
pr.title: refactor: use OrderStatus enum for order status

risk.why: Changes the type of the public field Order::status from String to OrderStatus, which breaks any downstream caller that compares or assigns strings. The change is brief-authorized and covered by characterization tests, but the rubric counts API changes that break callers as high. Files touched: 5 src files, no dependency or persistence changes, and no change in observable output (the test suite confirms this).
